html:
The Yuwibara, or Yuwi, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the coast around today's Mackay in central Queensland, at the mouth of the Pioneer River.

Their neighbours were the Biri and Giya to the north and inland, and the Baradha and Guwinmal to the south. The town of Mackay was founded in 1862, and sugar cane soon covered the river flats. It was worked largely by Pacific Islanders brought under the blackbirding labour trade. The frontier here was violent, and Yuwibara people lost their coast within a generation.
sum: The Yuwibara, or Yuwi, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the coast around today's Mackay in central Queensland, at the mouth of the Pioneer River.
